title: Ext to resolution sections comparison
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], an abelian sheaf $G$ on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$, let $G[0]\to I_G$ be the chosen injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Define $a_{X,G,q}:H^q(X,G)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(\Gamma(X,I_G))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] as the Ext/resolution equivalence from the constant integer sheaf, followed by the homology isomorphism of the chain map which evaluates a morphism from the constant integer sheaf at $1$. In Lean this is SheafPullbackResolution.extSectionsIso, whose data are the explicit composite extAddEquivCohomologyClass.toAddCommGrpIso and classSectionsIso.

source.place: Derived Categories, lemma-compute-ext-resolutions, part (1), with Hom from the constant integer sheaf evaluated at 1; cohomology.tex equation-functorial and equation-functorial-derived (Tags 01FA and 01F9).

proof_origin.note: Explicit Ext/resolution and evaluation construction. The chain-map proof applies Mathlib Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right directly; the duplicate private sectionsEquiv_naturality helper is removed in the landing repair.
